title: I ran git checkout -- . in the main tree by mistake

owner_note.text: While merging I ran a plain `git checkout -- .` in the main checkout, which reverted other agents' uncommitted edits to tracked files (e.g. .gitignore, ai/log.jsonl, page.jsonl, repo-size.md). Generated caches regenerate; hand edits there may need redoing. Also: the topic page is refined-asks.md, not asks.md, to avoid overwriting four hand-merged asks.md files.
